label: Monochrome Sunburst
description: One hue that gets lighter with each level, with grey leaves; energy use by area, unit and machine.
howTo: Bind `series.data` to a tree: `[{name, children: [{name, children: [{name, value}]}]}]`. Only leaves need a `value`; parents are the sum of their children.
Colours come from `series.levels` (index 0 is the invisible root, then one entry per ring). To change the hue, replace the two blues; the last entry is the grey used for the outer ring.
A leaf that sits on an inner ring (here “Chillers”) would take that ring’s colour; give it its own `itemStyle.color` in the data to keep it grey.
`sort: null` keeps the order of the data; remove it to sort sectors by size.

label: Sunburst VisualMap
description: Sectors coloured by their value through a continuous visualMap; downtime minutes by reason.
howTo: Bind `series.data` to a tree where EVERY node that should be coloured has a `value`; parents without a value are summed from their children.
Set `visualMap.max` to the largest value you expect (bind it if it varies) and adjust the colour ramp in `visualMap.inRange.color`.
The end captions of the colour bar are `visualMap.text` (`[high, low]`).

label: Sunburst Label Rotate
description: Each ring uses a different label rotation: tangential, radial, then horizontal.
howTo: Each ring has its own entry in `series.levels` (index 0 is the root): `label.rotate` is `"tangential"` (along the arc), `"radial"` (along the spoke) or a number of degrees (`0` = horizontal).
Bind `series.data` to your tree (`{name, value}` leaves, `{name, children}` branches). Use horizontal labels only on rings with wide sectors.
The ring colours are `levels[n].itemStyle.color`; remove them to colour by top-level branch instead.

label: Reason Wheel
description: Flavour-wheel layout: wide inner rings, a thin outer ring with labels outside and rounded corners.
howTo: Bind `series.data` to a three-level tree: category → group → reason, with a `value` on each reason.

Ring geometry is fixed per level in `series.levels[n].r0` / `r` (inner and outer radius). The outer ring is deliberately thin and puts its labels outside (`label.position: "outside"`), so leave about 40 % of the radius free for them.
Colours follow the top-level category (theme palette). Set `itemStyle.color` on a category node to pin it.
Reasons with very small values get crowded labels; group them into “Other” in your query or add `label.minAngle` to the outer level.

label: Rounded Sunburst
description: Ring-shaped sunburst with rounded, separated sectors and a hollow centre.
howTo: Bind `series.data` to your tree (`{name, value}` leaves, `{name, children}` branches).
The look comes from `series.itemStyle.borderRadius` and `borderWidth`; the hollow centre from the first value of `series.radius`.
`label.minAngle` hides labels of sectors narrower than that many degrees.
